09c_1_generic_condensate.png: Heat map of the 64 entries $T^\nu{}_\mu$ (row $\nu$, column $\mu$, both running over $x_0, \dots, x_7$) of a generic exact condensate of dirac16complex00 with effective mass $V = 5$, $\lambda = 0$, $H = 1$, a random unit column, at the point $a_4 = 0.5$, $a_4' = 0.25$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$, $b_4'/b_4 = 1/3$, $z = \pi/4$ of the history; colour scale from $-2$ to $2$ (entries beyond it are shown in the darkest colour and printed), in units of energy per unit volume. The diagonal holds only $-VS$ at $x_4$; 42 off-diagonal squares are nonzero, all of them produced by the spin connection. The squares $(x_4, x_0)$ and $(x_0, x_4)$ are zero.
09c_2_offdiagonal_entries.png: Three off-diagonal entries of the generic condensate of the previous figure ($V = 5$, $H = 1$, $a_4 = 0.5$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$, $b_4'/b_4 = 1/3$, $z = \pi/4$) against the rate $a_4'$ from $-1$ to $1$, in units of energy per unit volume. Left: the momentum flow $T^{x_4}{}_{x_1}$ comes from the $H$ part of the spin connection and does not depend on $a_4'$. Right: $T^{x_1}{}_{x_0}$ (dashed) is proportional to $a_4'$, and $T^{x_1}{}_{x_5}$ (solid) to $4a_4' - b_4'/b_4$, so it vanishes at $a_4' = 1/12$ (dotted line). Only when $a_4' = b_4' = 0$ do all entries but the 12 flows $T^{x_4}{}_{x_j}$ and $T^{x_j}{}_{x_4}$ vanish ($x_j$ one of $x_1, x_2, x_3, x_5, x_6, x_7$).
09c_3_witness_condensate.png: Heat map of the 64 entries $T^\nu{}_\mu$ of the exact witness condensate $\Phi = b_4^{-3/4}e^{-4ix_4}\Phi_0$ of the Revision record with $V = 5$, $H = 1$, $\lambda = 0$, at the same point ($a_4 = 0.5$, $a_4' = 0.25$, $b_4 = e^{2/3}$, $b_4'/b_4 = 1/3$, $z = \pi/4$; jet $\Phi_0$) and with the same colour scale as the generic condensate, in units of energy per unit volume. All 15 three-gamma bilinears of $\Phi_0$ vanish, so every off-diagonal entry is zero (by the record, at every point of every history): this condensate is a perfect fluid at rest, with $T^{x_4}{}_{x_4} = -VS$ and zero pressure.
09c_4_conservation_convergence.png: The largest of the eight components of the covariant divergence $\nabla_\mu T^\mu{}_\nu$ of the full tensor of a condensate ($m = 1$, $\lambda = 0.5$, $H = 0.25$, history $a_4 = 0.3x_4 + 0.05x_4^2$, $b_4 = e^{0.4x_4 - 0.02x_4^2}$, point $x_4 = 1$, $z = 0.5$), computed with central finite differences of step $h$, against $h$ from $0.2$ to $0.0002$; both axes logarithmic, the divergence in units of energy per unit volume per unit length. For the true condensate (circles) it falls like $h^2$ (dotted line): the exact divergence is zero. For the control (squares), which leaves out the part $3H\gamma^{(0)}$ of the field equation, it stays near $0.05$: its tensor is not conserved.
